# Evolving Skill Packs

## Core principle

Evolving skill packs within meta lifecycle boundaries. Deterministic checks own scope, typed preconditions, evidence, and coverage; the agent performs only the domain judgment that cannot be encoded safely.

## Do not activate when

- the requested outcome does not require evolving skill packs within meta lifecycle boundaries
- the typed inputs for evolving-skill-packs are absent and another technique owns the outcome
